title: Summit — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Summit.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "ADA Compliant Specialist." Value tier. Summit Appliance (Felix Storch) makes over 1,000 SKUs of compact, ADA-compliant, and specialized refrigeration. They serve healthcare, laboratory, hospitality, and residential markets with appliances nobody else makes — pharmacy-grade fridges, ADA-height ranges, and medical-grade storage.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: ADA-compliant needs, healthcare facilities, small spaces, specialty applications.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Summit:

• Over 1,000 SKUs — if you need a specialized appliance, Summit probably makes it

• ADA-compliant models across every category

• Medical and pharmaceutical-grade refrigeration

• Smallest footprint appliances available

• Serves markets no other consumer brand touches
